verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing's own docs say it automates recurring payments, creates custom pricing plans, and handles trials and renewals. The customer portal provides subscription management, and the documented API surface includes subscription create/update/cancel. A hands-on community report describes setting up recurring payments in under an hour. missing for 10: explicit documentation of plan upgrades/downgrades and proration behavior, deeper first-party subscription lifecycle docs in the pack.
